## 7.6 Federated civic pilots

Municipal pilots can test civic feedback, participatory governance, youth literacy, and cross-regional collaboration across different local conditions. European municipal frameworks are one proposed starting context, with city/citizen ownership arrangements addressed in DP20.

Federated trials should share reusable development and evidence rather than repeat isolated setup. Cohort selection should document actual participation, funding, and governance conditions, and what risks earlier cohorts absorb relative to benefits later cohorts receive. Reuse should preserve differences among contexts, not imply that one city’s result automatically generalizes.
